samples.prompt: Ask Ms Brown at a local centre for information about a neighbourhood walking event. Explain your needs, ask about the time and cost, and find out whether it suits beginners.

samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to request further information about a neighbourhood walking event. I am interested in walking as a daily habit and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích mình cần thông tin gì.

Ms Brown

parts.text:
,

I am writing to request further information about
a neighbourhood walking event

parts.text: . I am interested in
walking as a daily habit
parts.labelVi: chủ đề

parts.text: and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to request further information about [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am interested in [chủ đề] and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.label: Nhu cầu
paragraphs.text: My main concern is that I have limited experience and would prefer a practical introduction. I understand that participants will explore a short local route and note useful improvements. This interests me because people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip.
